entries.name: ProductShell
entries.purpose: Product detail screen shell composing AppScreen with product top/bottom chrome.
strain_notes: Domain shell should remain thin; generic chrome belongs to templates/global organisms.

entries.name: ProductSummaryCard
entries.purpose: Product summary mapping product data to SummaryCard/MediaBlock.
strain_notes: If non-product summaries need the same shape, extract back into SummaryCard axes.

entries.name: ProductOptionSelector
entries.purpose: Product option data mapped to SectionCard + SelectableList.
strain_notes: Selection semantics are molecule-level; product organism should mainly map data.

entries.name: ProductBenefitList
entries.purpose: Product benefit data mapped to SectionCard + InfoList.
strain_notes: Cross-domain benefit/effect lists should use InfoList directly or a global flow summary wrapper.

entries.name: ProductPromoBanner
strain_notes: Policy notice should not route through this wrapper.

entries.name: ProductPurchaseBar
entries.purpose: Product sticky purchase CTA wrapper over StickyActionBar.
strain_notes: Execution-flow CTAs should use flow CTA vocabulary instead.
